description: This file defines the ResponseFactory class, which implements the ResponseFactoryInterface to create HTTP response objects with a specified status code and reason phrase within the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating PSR-7 Response objects with a given status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a new Response object with the specified status code and optional reason phrase.
